_note: Production policy data extracted directly from Prudential PruMed Master Policy PRU/MED/041206/2023 for The Registered Trustees of Church of Uganda (KIDO Programme).
name: Prudential PruMed Insurance Policy (KIDO Programme)

age_rules.text: Unmarried children, stepchildren, and legally adopted children born term (34 weeks or more) are covered up to a maximum of 18 years of age, residing with the insured member and dependent on them for support.
Children aged over 18 years shall only be eligible if they are full-time students at a school, college, or university, residing with parents, and not aged above 25 years.
Standard entry age for principal members and spouses is up to 70 years. Cover extends up to 75 years for continuing existing members.
Members aged 70 up to 80 years at entry qualify under the Senior Citizens cover tier. Continuing members may renew up to 85 years.

benefits.name: Inpatient care
benefits.text: Inpatient care covers hospital accommodation, nursing care, diagnostic services, operating theatre, intensive care units, specialist visits, and discharge drugs for up to 7 days.

benefits.name: Outpatient care
benefits.text: Outpatient care covers general practitioner consultations, specialist referrals, laboratory diagnostic tests, radiology, prescribed drugs for up to 1 month, and physiotherapy up to 10 sessions.

benefits.name: Dental care
benefits.text: Dental care covers dental consultations, routine examinations, non-surgical extractions, normal compound fillings (excluding precious metals), root canal treatments, dental x-rays, and scaling and polishing once per year.

benefits.name: Optical care
benefits.text: Optical care covers consultations with an optometrist or ophthalmologist, one routine eye test per policy year, and prescribed spectacles (lenses and frames once every 2 years). Contact lenses are not provided.

benefits.name: Maternity care
benefits.text: Maternity care covers hospital delivery fees, normal and caesarean delivery, inpatient complications of pregnancy, and routine prenatal/postnatal care (covered under outpatient) for principal members and legal spouses only.

benefits.name: Pre-existing and Chronic conditions
benefits.text: Covers management of declared pre-existing conditions, newly diagnosed chronic conditions, cancer chemotherapy, and HIV/AIDS care including ARV treatment within the designated chronic sub-limits.

benefits.name: Emergency ambulance
benefits.text: Local road ambulance evacuation within Uganda for transportation of a sick member to the nearest suitable hospital for eligible inpatient emergency treatment.

benefits.name: Last expense funeral cover
benefits.text: Cash payout upon written notification of the death of an insured member while the policy is in force, ranging from UGX 500,000 to UGX 3,000,000 based on tier.

waiting_periods.text: Outpatient services are provided immediately from the commencement date with zero waiting period.
A waiting period of 3 months (90 days) applies to inpatient hospitalization services from the commencement date for new members.
A waiting period of 8 months (240 days) applies to maternity and childbirth services from the commencement date.
A waiting period of 12 months (365 days) applies to pre-existing conditions and newly diagnosed chronic illnesses.
A waiting period of 12 months applies to planned elective surgeries.
A waiting period of 24 months (2 years) applies to organ transplant procedures.

exclusions.text: Preventative dental examinations, prophylaxis treatment, dentures, false teeth, dental implants, cosmetic procedures, precious metals, and orthodontic treatment are excluded.
Sunglasses, plano (non-prescription) lenses, and contact lenses are excluded.
Any type of infertility treatment, contraception, sterilization or fertilization, assisted reproduction (e.g. IVF), voluntary abortion, and maternity cover for dependent children are excluded.
Any pre-existing medical condition that the insured person was aware of at commencement which was not disclosed on the application form is excluded.
Hospitalization costs for a new member will not be covered if the member in question was already admitted before joining the scheme.
Cosmetic, reconstructive, or remedial disorders, keloid or scar removal, breast reduction or enlargement, obesity, weight control, and body piercing/tattooing treatments are excluded.

Injuries or medical conditions resulting from substance abuse, alcoholism, self-inflicted injuries, hazardous sports (e.g. sky diving, martial arts), military operations, riots, or criminal acts are excluded.
